input.content: P1 test pattern (settings client): the stub `send` in tests/test_client.py was edited to return the new response shape ({"ok": True, "applied": True}) that the released provider never returns. That edit hid a compatibility regression. Test doubles for a provider that ships independently should model the supported release (eval-release:provider/settings.py returns {"ok": True}), with separate tests for the new contract behind its flag.
